note: The committed single signature document, read both compressed and plain. Its inspect output is the reference that most other groups reuse, since re-signing and reordering cases are expected to report the same two headers.

cases.name: Inspect Compressed
cases.note: The gzipped form of the same document reports identically, so compression is transparent to the reader.

cases.name: Verify Correct Private Key
cases.note: A private key verifies through its public half, so passing the signing key works.

cases.name: Verify Incorrect Public Key
cases.note: A failed verify must not leave behind the zero byte output that opening the destination too early would create.

cases.name: Verify Unsigned
cases.note: A plain document is valid input, it simply carries no signature for the key to match.

cases.name: Inspect Read Only Input
cases.note: Reading a document must not require permission to modify it.

cases.name: Sign Read Only Input
cases.note: Signing to a separate destination reads the input only, so a read only source is fine. Ed25519 is deterministic, so the result is the committed document byte for byte.
